---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem using fictional data
---

## Problem

Expected and observed behavior.

## Reproduction

Steps and minimal fictional inputs. Never attach a real CV, API key or unredacted trace.

## Environment

Release/commit, operating system, Node version, browser and configured model name.

## Evidence

Redacted error code or screenshot. For AI issues, include the expected category and supporting fictional quote; distinguish missing evidence from contradiction.
